knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: q-Hockey Stick identity proved (0 sorries, 0 axioms). Fixed incorrect statement (q^{j(k+1)} -> q^{(k+1)(N-j)}) and proved by induction on N using q-Pascal recurrence.
builtItems: qHockeyStick: q-hockey stick identity proved by induction on N
Fixed statement: original used q^{j(k+1)} which is wrong for q≠1; corrected to q^{(k+1)(N-j)}
insights: Original q-hockey stick statement was WRONG for q≠1 (verified: q=2,k=1,N=1 gives 13≠7)
Correct q-weight is q^{(k+1)(N-j)} (geometric weighting from the top), not q^{j(k+1)}
Proof uses reverse accumulation: each recurrence step multiplies running sum by q^{k+1}
Key lemma: Nat.succ_sub + Nat.mul_succ to handle exponent arithmetic in ℕ
Finset.sum_congr rfl is the right approach when rewriting inside a finset sum with membership constraints
